name: craft3d

scripts.test: esbuild scripts/geometry-check.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.scratch/geometry-check.mjs --log-level=error --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && cp node_modules/manifold-3d/manifold.wasm .scratch/manifold.wasm && node .scratch/geometry-check.mjs && esbuild scripts/agent-check.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.scratch/agent-check.mjs --log-level=error --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node .scratch/agent-check.mjs && npm run -s agent:build && node scripts/agent-servers-check.mjs
scripts.agent:build: esbuild scripts/agent/mcp.ts scripts/agent/http.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=dist-agent --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=error --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild src/core/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-agent/craft3d-core.mjs --log-level=error --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && cp node_modules/manifold-3d/manifold.wasm dist-agent/manifold.wasm
scripts.test:slicer: esbuild scripts/slicer-check.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.scratch/slicer-check.mjs --log-level=error --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && cp node_modules/manifold-3d/manifold.wasm .scratch/manifold.wasm && node .scratch/slicer-check.mjs

description: Autora 3D — a sketch-and-extrude CAD modeler for Autora
